\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{calc}
\newcommand{\calcpath}{\draw ($2*(1,1 -| a)-(0,-1mm)$) -- (2,2);}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \coordinate (a) at (0,0);
  \draw ($(1,1 |- a)+(0,-1mm)$) -- (2,2);
  \calcpath
\end{tikzpicture}
Ordinary math ($x + y$).
